text:
jamie: FYI I opened a small TF PR to add an aws_vpc_endpoint_service for analytics-cluster in shared-network account. Need quick check on acceptance flow and route tables before I merge.

sasha: link? PR?

jamie: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pulls/842

kevin: quick read — main concerns: (1) ensure `acceptance_required = true` on service and that the consumer account runs `aws_vpc_endpoint_connection_accepter` (we usually have acct-level module). (2) SGs: endpoint service requires the endpoint's SG to allow inbound from consumer VPC. (3) route table — for interface endpoints no route needed but for gateway endpoints you need route table assoc.

maria: we're using interface endpoint (private DNS) right? analytics uses k8s egress to S3 + internal API. Does the analytics cluster live in the same org account? If cross-account, acceptance step must be manual or auto-accept role.

jamie: it's cross-account, shared-network (owner) publishing the service, consumer = analytics-prod (different AWS account). I added a role ARN for the accepter: `module.endpoint_service.accept_role_arn` and `accept_connection = true` in consumer module. but not 100% on whether the proxy acceptance lambda runs in the other account.

kevin: can you paste the TF snippet?

jamie: ```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint_service" "analytics" {
  acceptance_required = true
  network_load_balancer_arns = [aws_lb.analytics_nlb.arn]
}

resource "aws_ec2_transit_gateway" "unused" { # placeholder
}
```

kevin: ok NLB + interface endpoints is fine. Two notes: (A) ensure the NLB SG permits health checks from the endpoint IPs (they come from ENIs in consumer VPC). (B) The consumer needs `aws_vpc_endpoint` with `service_name` pointing to the service and then either an acceptor automation in shared-network or manual accept in console.

sasha: infra-bot automation: do we have a cross-account acceptor lambda? @infra-bot

infra-bot: We have a provisioner that runs in shared-network to auto-accept connections if `auto_accept=true` and IAM role `endpoint:AcceptVpcEndpointConnections` is delegated. See playbook infra/acceptor/README.

maria: also check DNS: if you want private DNS to resolve the internal API, consumer must enable `private_dns_enabled` on the endpoint and the service must be consumer-visible.

jamie: thanks. Two quick asks before I merge:
- can someone confirm the acceptor role pattern is safe to grant to analytics-prod CI?
- should I add a route53 private zone association step in the consumer module or leave it to apps team?

kevin: approve on pattern, but scope the role to only `ec2:AcceptVpcEndpointConnections` + resource ARNs, no wildcard. route53 association we usually do in infra module so apps don't need privileges. add it.

sasha: :thumbsup: also add a small note in the PR body about who will own acceptance if something goes sideways.

jamie: will do. merging after I add role constraining + route53 block. thanks!

deploy-bot: PR #842 merged by jamie (main) — deploy pipeline queued :rocket:
